limits_note: Priced per day, which is hostile to a steady 1 TiB/day: $375/day at 400 Mbps is $11,250/month, and even the $0.058/GB effective rate is worse than Proxyrack's $5/TB equivalent at the same volume. The $10/3-day 25 Mbps entry is a trial, not a product tier (no auto-renew, 3 days only). Speed caps make this predictable but expensive.
reliability_note: Day-rate billing with no volume discount path; guaranteed throughput is per-session, not aggregate across threads.
